defs.def: two times; on two occasions 两次；两遍

ex.s: She signed up on the website Bookalokal, and now welcomes ___43___ into her Brussels flat twice a week for dinner parties.
ex.t: 例如，一条浑浊的小溪流经植物和居住着微小生物的岩石后往往会变清澈。

ex.s: Today, there are about 2,000 or more grizzly bears in the US Their recovery has been so successful that the US Fish and Wildlife Service has twice attempted to delist grizzlies, which would loosen legal protections and allow them to be hunted.
ex.t: 如今，美国大约有2000头或更多的灰熊。它们的种群恢复非常成功，以至于美国鱼类和野生动物管理局曾两次试图将灰熊移出名录，而这会放松法律保护并允许猎杀它们。

ex.s: Yet the exact opposite was true: the participants who made deliberate errors learned about twice as much as the people who simply copied out the correct definitions.
ex.t: 但为什么我们会觉得有些艺术作品美丽而有些丑陋呢？

ex.s: The traffic signals along Factoria Boulevard in Bellevue, Washington, generally don't flash the same length of green twice in a row, especially at rush hour.
ex.t: 华盛顿州贝尔维尤市法克托里亚大道上的交通信号灯通常不会连续两次亮相同时长的绿灯，尤其是在高峰时段。

ex.s: The obvious one is money; eating out once or twice a week may be   62  (afford) but doing this most days adds up.
ex.t: 如果你不想遭受这个问题，那么我建议下次你去妈妈家吃晚餐时向她请教一些烹饪技巧。

ex.s: The passages or conversation you will be asked several questions, the passages and the conversation will be read twice, but the questions will be spoken only once.
ex.t: 游客不应忽视它，因为它在历史上遭受了很多苦难。

ex.s: A lady sitting in her rocking and shaking home, saw the wall part from the ceiling, open and shut twice, like a mouth, and then drop the end of a brick on the floor like a tooth.
ex.t: 一位女士坐在摇晃震动的家中，看见墙壁与天花板裂开，像一张嘴似的张开又合上两次，然后像掉牙齿一样，把一块砖的末端摔落在地上。

ex.s: Of course, exploration doesn’t have to mean blindly throwing ourselves into the unknown, and it’s never wrong to think twice before taking action.
ex.t: 当然，探索未必意味着盲目投身未知，行动前三思也绝无不当。

ex.s: One word will be used twice.
ex.t: 有一个词会被使用两次。

ex.s: And in America, people who receive 25% of their daily calories or more through sugar are twice as likely to die from heart disease than people who receive less than 10% a day (Journal of the American Medical Association, 2014).
ex.t: 在美国，每天通过糖摄入 25% 或更多热量的人，死于心脏病的可能性是每天摄入少于 10% 的人的两倍（《美国医学会杂志》，2014 年）。

defs.def: double in quantity, rate, etc. 两倍
